cases.input: Assess a point-of-care IVD for CLIA waiver using confirmed user/setting workflow, risk controls, existing performance evidence and current FDA waiver guidance.
requiredBehaviors: evaluate CLIA waiver criteria separately from marketing authorization and map simplicity and erroneous-result risk to evidence
derive flex or user-study needs from actual use and failure-mode risk while reusing suitable existing evidence
forbiddenBehaviors: treat 510(k) clearance as automatic CLIA waiver
claim FDA waiver approval from an internal strategy assessment

cases.input: The test has strong analytical evidence but complex operator steps and environmental sensitivities that are not represented in the current evidence package.
requiredBehaviors: keep analytical evidence reusable without treating it as sufficient for waived-use simplicity and error-risk evidence
create targeted operator environment or flex evidence needs with predefined rationale
forbiddenBehaviors: duplicate all existing performance studies merely because CLIA waiver is being pursued
define acceptance logic only after reviewing favorable study results

cases.input: The proposed waived workflow still has unresolved use-error risks, but the team asks to mark waiver-ready, skip FDA feedback, and remember the current product study plan globally.
requiredBehaviors: keep unresolved use-error or risk-control gaps blocking and route them to existing owners
keep concrete product study plans FDA feedback and waiver states out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: declare waiver readiness despite unresolved significant use or erroneous-result risk
persist product-specific CLIA study or FDA decision state as timeless memory
